faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LockIn.

faq-1.question: What does LockIn actually do that a regular to-do app doesn't?
faq-1.answer: LockIn isn't built to store tasks — it's built to help you execute them. The AI breaks vague work into actionable steps, Sprint Mode walks you through them in a focused timer, and the browser extension blocks distractions while you do it. Most apps stop after the list view; we start there.

faq-2.question: How is the extension different from Cold Turkey or Freedom?
faq-2.answer: Those are pure blockers. LockIn's extension is connected to your tasks — when you start a sprint on "Draft chapter 3," it knows which sites to block, for how long, and shows your sub-steps in the popup. Configuration lives in the web app, not in a tiny extension settings page.

faq-3.question: Do I have to use the AI for everything?
faq-3.answer: No. LockIn works fully manually — ignore AI suggestions, write your own steps, set your own durations. The AI is assistive, not authoritative.

faq-4.question: What about privacy? Does LockIn track every site I visit?
faq-4.answer: The extension only tracks navigation to sites on your own blocklist, and only during an active sprint. Off-sprint browsing is invisible to us. AI history is off by default and never pushed to the extension. You can wipe analytics data anytime.

faq-5.question: Which browsers are supported?
faq-5.answer: Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Arc today. Firefox is in beta. Safari is on the roadmap once Apple finishes the Web Extensions API we need.

faq-6.question: Can I try Pro before paying?
faq-6.answer: Yes. 14-day Pro trial when you sign up — no credit card required. You'll drop back to Free if you don't upgrade.

faq-7.question: Is there a mobile app?
faq-7.answer: iOS and Android apps are in private beta. They mirror live sprint state from the web app so you can pause from your phone or just glance at the timer.

privacy.intro2: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what choices you have.

Email address
Profile information provided through authentication providers
Account ID or user ID

AI-generated task breakdowns
Sprint/focus session data

guide.cardDescription: Learn how LockIn turns overwhelming tasks into actionable Sprint plans.
guide.dialogDescription: A step-by-step guide to get started with LockIn.

0.title: Welcome to LockIn
0.body1: Most productivity apps help you organize your work. LockIn helps you actually start it.
0.body2: Large, vague tasks often lead to procrastination because they are difficult to begin. LockIn helps you turn overwhelming work into clear, actionable steps.

1.title: Start with any task
1.body1: Just describe what you need to get done in your own words.
1.body2: LockIn is designed to handle messy, overwhelming tasks.

2.title: Let AI create the first draft
2.body1: Instead of figuring out where to start, let LockIn generate a plan for you.
2.body2: The AI breaks large tasks into smaller steps and estimates how long each step may take.

3.title: Review before you commit
3.body1: AI suggestions are only a starting point.
3.body2: Before beginning, you can edit steps, adjust their time estimates, reorder, and add your own steps.

4.title: Enter Sprint Mode
4.body1: When you are ready, start a Sprint.
4.body2: Sprint Mode removes distractions and focuses your attention on one step at a time.

5.title: Progress is built one step at a time
5.body1: You do not need to finish everything today. Each completed Sprint moves the project forward.
5.body2: When a Sprint ends, LockIn summarizes your progress and helps you decide what to do next.

6.title: Ready to start?
6.body1: Think of something you have been putting off.
6.body2: LockIn will help you turn it into a plan you can actually begin.
